### [Education Report: How educators use Claude](https://www.anthropic.com/news/anthropic-education-report-how-educators-use-claude)

**Anthropic** · 2026-09-10

Anthropic analyzed 74,000 anonymized Claude.ai conversations from higher education professionals alongside Northeastern University survey data to reveal how university educators use AI.

- Analyzed approximately 74,000 anonymized May-June conversations from Claude.ai Free and Pro accounts linked to higher education email addresses.
- Mapped user interactions to postsecondary teaching and administrative tasks defined in the U.S. Department of Labor's O*NET database.
- Curriculum development emerged as the primary use case, followed by academic research and assessing student performance.
- Northeastern University faculty qualitative surveys showed educators spend an average of 29% of their AI time on personal learning.
- In a cited Gallup survey, teachers reported that AI tools save them an average of 5.9 hours per week.

**Why it matters:** The findings shift the AI education debate from student academic integrity to empirical patterns of faculty adoption across teaching, research, and course administration.

`ai` `education` `claude` `higher-ed` `anthropic`
